generation.before_using_ai_generation_an: Before using AI generation, answer review, question concerns, or reports, configure the API URL, key, default model, and star-specific models in Admin, then test the API.
generation.without_an_api_key_the_questi: Without an API key, the question bank, rule-based grading, statistics, and mock generation remain available. Real AI features fall back to mock or rule-based results.
generation.generate_sets_supports_batch_: Generate sets supports batch AI generation and practice while generating. Approved questions become available first; later questions are appended.
generation.learner_mode_hides_admin_by_d: Learner mode hides Admin by default. Administrator mode exposes model settings, AI generation, transfers, and test-data cleanup.
generation.question_concerns_are_not_hin: Question concerns are not hints. The prompt prohibits answers, candidate answers, solution steps, key ideas, formula applications, and suggested next steps.
generation.you_can_customize_counts_by_s: You can customize counts by star level. AI-mixed or AI-only tests with gap filling first select available questions, then generate and review missing ones before creating the test.
generation.export_a_redacted_diagnostic_: Export a redacted diagnostic package in Admin to investigate startup failures, unresponsive APIs, stuck generation, database issues, or release-file problems.
generation.diagnostics_include_configura: Diagnostics include configuration summaries, SQLite integrity and PRAGMA state, table counts, failed job/batch snapshots, recent audit and AI-call summaries, and disk space.
generation.generation_and_filtering_supp: Generation and filtering support multiple tags to jointly constrain knowledge, methods, and structure.
generation.custom_tags_have_a_category_n: Custom tags have a category, name, and description. The description enters generation requests to explain its intended scope.
generation.add_a_temporary_tag_in_genera: Add a temporary tag in Generate sets when you only need an extra condition for the current request.
generation.generate_by_tags_custom_descr: Generate by tags, custom description, stars, count, concurrency, candidate count, non-AI examples, AI anti-duplicate examples, and extra constraints.
generation.by_default_similar_unattempte: By default, similar unattempted AI questions of the same star level are reused without model calls or generation costs. Only the shortfall is generated.
generation.the_pipeline_includes_example: The pipeline includes example retrieval, parallel strategies, JSON and rule validation, independent review, set deduplication, and best-candidate publication.
generation.difficulty_is_not_self_assess: Difficulty is not self-assessed by the generator. Difficulty and premium guidelines enter the prompt, and the reviewer independently assigns six-dimensional and premium scores.
generation.a_candidate_is_rejected_if_it: A candidate is rejected if its answer_spec cannot accept the reviewer's independent answer. The answer_spec_inconsistent reason supports targeted retries.
generation.admin_shows_daily_and_lifetim: Admin shows daily and lifetime calls, tokens, and estimated cost. Budget overruns block new real generation by default, but not mock workflows or complete reuse.
generation.fast_uses_1_3_1_for_workflow_: Fast uses 1/3/1 for workflow trials. Strict uses 5/8/5 for quality, with more generation, review, waiting, and cost.
generation.candidate_count_controls_how_: Candidate count controls how many candidates compete for each final question after review and deduplication. More candidates mean more selection headroom, not necessarily higher difficulty.
generation.disable_prefer_reusing_unatte: Disable Prefer reusing unattempted AI questions to require new generation. Default reuse reduces latency and cost.
generation.the_backend_freezes_a_call_bu: The backend freezes a call-budget snapshot when creating a job or batch. If candidate and question counts exceed local generation/review limits, creation is rejected before any paid calls.
generation.configure_secondary_reviewer_: Configure Secondary reviewer in Admin for strict two-reviewer arbitration, preferably using a different model from the generator and primary reviewer.
generation.strict_mode_supports_a_review: Strict mode supports a reviewer-model allowlist. Empty means no extra restriction; otherwise unlisted reviewers block publication unless degradation is explicitly accepted.
generation.you_do_not_need_to_wait_for_t: You do not need to wait for the entire set. Sync the first approved questions to practice while generation continues.
generation.copy_configuration_fills_the_: Copy configuration fills the generation form without starting a new batch. Review tags, models, and advanced settings before starting.
generation.if_provider_failures_rejectio: If provider failures, rejection, or timeouts leave a partial batch, Fill remaining preserves accepted questions and retries only missing/failed slots after a new budget check, bounded by remaining attempts.
generation.batch_cards_show_target_accep: Batch cards show target, accepted, rejected and failed counts, remaining-time estimates, ETA reliability, and item status.
generation.reports_cover_all_history_one: Reports cover all history, one session, or one generation batch, filtered by date, mode, source, stars, premium rating, and tags.
generation.session_reports_describe_one_: Session reports describe one attempt, batch reports assess generated-question quality, and history reports show longer-term trends.
generation.assign_separate_models_to_pla: Assign separate models to planning, generation, review, reports, diagnosis, hints, fault review, set review, and answer review. Blank roles use the default model.
generation.if_any_checks_fail_inspect_ga: If any checks fail, inspect gaps before using new prompts/models for real generation. Add gold cases, required prompt fields, or duplicate fixes as needed.
generation.export_history_creates_json_c: Export history creates JSON containing answers, reports, AI generation, generated questions, variant lineage, custom tags, and AI logs.
generation.choose_all_history_or_the_act: Choose all history or the active learner. Learner-only packages contain that learner's answers, reports, review sessions, and related generation traces for separate transfer or backup.
generation.clearing_removes_sessions_sub: Clearing removes sessions, submissions, events, wrong records, reports, AI generation, generated questions, and AI logs.
generation.real_generation_fails_closed_: Real generation fails closed on provider timeouts, errors, or invalid JSON. It never silently publishes mock questions. More candidates increase real-call volume without bypassing safety checks.
generation.interrupting_a_batch_stops_ne: Interrupting a batch stops new dispatch. Already-running provider requests are logged but late results never enter the practice pool.
generation.batch_pages_aggregate_failure: Batch pages aggregate failure/rejection/cancellation reasons and retain configuration snapshots. Inspect reasons, ETA confidence, running counts, and budgets before refreshing, filling, or interrupting.
generation.a_disconnected_progress_strea: A disconnected progress stream retains its batch ID and resumes from the last event. Expired running jobs become timed_out rather than running forever.
generation.generation_speed_depends_on_p: Generation speed depends on provider latency, concurrency, review count, and retries. ETA ranges with low reliability usually reflect sparse records or a new run.
generation.the_core_knowledge_area_that_: The core knowledge area that determines the main direction of question generation.
generation.a_locally_added_generation_ta: A locally added generation tag with an optional description.
generation.cannot_fill_a_batch_in_its_cu: Cannot fill a batch in its current state
generation.generate_automatically_gradab: Generate automatically gradable upper-elementary mathematics questions; avoid near-duplicates that only change numbers.
generation.heavy_ai_tasks_queue_automati: Heavy AI tasks queue automatically. Inspect batch generation, similar questions, test gap filling, hints, reports, and repair suggestions here.
generation.example_generate_10_three_sta: Example: Generate 10 three-star Russian competition questions focused on number theory, without reusing AI questions.

generation.approved_batch_questions_appe: Approved batch questions appear here and can be answered immediately.
